entries.en: Dammit... I wanna go home...
I don't wanna go to school...[n]This sucks...
I'm so tired every day...

Look, there's a bunch[n]over there, too!

Looks like they're[n]searching the premises...
Another psychotic[n]breakdown? I can't[n]handle this...
Does it have something to do[n]with those posters we saw?
Did they arrest the[n]Phantom Thieves?

Medjed hasn't taken[n]any action either...

Did Medjed do that?

The Phantom Thieves will[n]do something about it!

It's probably impossible. We'd[n]need some sort of miracle...

Apparently some ATMs[n]aren't working...
I heard someone's[n]tampering with the system.
Is it Medjed?[n]No, it couldn't be...
What are the police doing?[n]They're so incompetent...
Even the Phantom Thieves[n]couldn't stop them...
I knew the Phantom[n]Thieves would pull[n]through!
Can you believe they[n]actually took down hackers!?
It's cool how they[n]don't reveal what[n]they're doing.
Who's that guy that was[n]criticizing them? Akechi?
It's pretty lame to[n]just criticize without[n]doing anything yourself.
I'm so curious who the[n]Phantom Thieves really are.
Miss! Miss! Want me[n]to steal your heart?

entries.en: Is that a pick-up line?[n]Don't make me laugh.
Apparently they're even famous[n]overseas! Isn't that nuts?
I wish I could join[n]the Phantom Thieves...
You know Akechi?[n]That annoying dude?
I always change the[n]channel when I see him.
All he ever does[n]is nitpick.
There's no way the Phantom[n]Thieves are the bad guys!
He's so desperate.[n]It's kinda lame.
Who should I vote[n]for in the rankings?
Isn't this kind[n]of interesting?
Akechi's a detective, right?[n]He seems kind of incompetent.
He talks big, but he[n]doesn't even do anything.
Ugh! I hate people like[n]that. They're all talk!
Okumura Foods again?[n]Did something happen?
They're getting sued. Apparently[n]they're pretty shady.
You mean how they[n]screwed their employees[n]for the sake of profit?
If he's that corrupt, then[n]he deserves to be targeted.
This is where the Phantom[n]Thieves should come in!
Who needs police when we[n]have the Phantom Thieves?
So true!
So much for being a[n]great detective.[n]Akechi-kun is finished.
I'm really curious about[n]their true identities!
Those calling card posters[n]are collector's items now!
Don't tell me the[n]Phantom Thieves did that[n]to President Okumura...
They're heroes! They[n]would never do that!

...I can't think of any[n]other explanation.[n]That has to be it!
What does that detective[n]think he's doing?
He's just trying to[n]get popular, isn't he?[n]He wants to stand out.
Just hurry up and[n]arrest the Phantom[n]Thieves already...
I'm curious... It seems[n]like he knows something.
I bet he found out some[n]really juicy secret!
They still haven't[n]caught the culprit?
What are the police doing!?
Do your job! You're[n]nothing but tax thieves!
How long are they going to let[n]the Phantom Thieves run free!?
This country's done for...[n]Someone better take[n]responsibility!
Isn't that Shido[n]guy amazing?
I don't know much about[n]politics, but I like Shido!
This is the first time[n]I've felt like voting.
I was really moved when[n]I heard his speech!
He's gonna be prime minister,[n]right? That's so cool!
Was Shido-san actually[n]a bad guy...?
Hrm... I don't[n]know anymore.
I told you, you can't[n]trust phantom thieves...
What's Akechi-kun saying?
If the country's in trouble,[n]then Shido-san should be fine!
I've already given up on[n]that dream. I want to take[n]better care of myself.
Drink with the group?[n]Are you stupid? You can't drink[n]during a discussion.
The manager? He's always been[n]reliable. He's so considerate of[n]his subordinates, too.
You're going to forgive[n]your boyfriend? What if he[n]starts hurting you again...?
What are you talking[n]about!? He's never done that![n]We're totally happy together!
I think the moderate pay and[n]work are what fit me the most.
If things are tough, then[n]just forget about them.
I don't have any[n]empathy about that hero stuff,[n]y'know? It's old news now.
I'm getting tired. This is why we[n]shouldn't overwork ourselves...
This is how things should be... Right...?
